criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.note: First two lines stand alone within ~210 chars, name a specific deadline (July 1 fiscal year), establish a live structural tension (every AI-economy mechanism sat idle). A 9 not 10 because no dollar figure or named contract appears in the opener itself.

criteria.name: Industry relevance
criteria.note: Every story carries both an AK anchor and a named industry consequence: NDAA/defense contractors at JBER/Eielson/Fort Wainwright ($2.6B); LNG/AI-compute power-cost ($55B); RFLP/Railbelt utilities; workforce vetoes with dollar amounts; Lohmeier $8B signal; RHTP Aug 1 grants.

criteria.name: Factual density
criteria.note: Specifics every 1-2 sentences: 198-224 vote, AFCEC-26-R-0006, named bases, dollar amounts, named individuals and orgs, and a dense date spine (June 29/30, July 1/16/17/19, Aug 1).

criteria.name: Source quality
criteria.note: All claims sourced; most high-confidence items double-sourced with a primary. Two single-sourced items (Lohmeier ExecutiveGov-only, JBER.mil 403'd, not primary; AI CSAM ADN-only, primary-adjacent public law) cap this at 7 per rubric.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.note: Analytical, structural, position-taking. 'All dates, no closes' and 'The human pipeline got cut the same week the gas-line tax bill stalled' land the desk voice. No influencer cadence or boilerplate.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.note: ~466 words, ~2900 chars, tight 2-3 sentence paragraphs, one 3-item single-clause bullet block. Scans on desktop and mobile.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.note: Names the specific capital-vs-calendar tension, two genuine opposing positions, no softener or CTA.

criteria.name: Business actionability
criteria.note: Concrete revisit triggers: Aug 1 RHTP awardees, July 16-19 LNG window, DAF RFLP evaluation open now, shrinking workforce credential pipeline.

hard_fails.name: hashtag_count_in_range
hard_fails.detail: Exactly 5 whitelist hashtags on a single closing line; none inline.

hard_fails.name: punctuation_bans_held
hard_fails.detail: Zero em-dashes, en-dashes, double-hyphens, colons, or semicolons in the body or hashtag line.

hard_fails.name: total_char_count_under_linkedin_cap
hard_fails.detail: ~2900 characters (body + hashtag line), under the 3000 cap.
